records.title: Crypto Market Cooling Off? ETH & SOL Risk Levels Examined
records.summary_text:
[CW note] From the CryptoWeeklies video of 17 September 2026.

[2026-09-17_ETH_SOL]  
Video Title: Crypto Market Cooling Off? ETH & SOL Risk Levels Examined  
Video ID: yajoy_71M38  
ETH & SOL (ETH_SOL) | Class: CRYPTO  

 Current Structure  
- The risk oscillator has recently slipped below the 40 % threshold, signalling a shift from the moderate‑risk zone into a neutral accumulation phase (20‑40 %).  
- Both ETH and SOL sit in the accumulation territory, with composite risk scores of 41/100 for ETH and 40/100 for SOL; BTC is at 44/100.  
- The 200‑week SMA and all‑time‑high drawdown metrics confirm that the pair has been rallying evenly for the past 90 days, keeping the social‑sentiment wordcloud momentum largely bullish.  

 Macro Quantitative Risk  
- The TWAP baseline is not explicitly stated, but the risk oscillator’s 40 % benchmark serves as the de‑facto TWAP risk level for the asset class.  
- Regression fair‑value bands place ETH and SOL two standard deviations below fair value during deep capitulation (June‑August 2026) and one standard deviation below during the current green‑zone accumulation.  
- Residual zones: the base target for ETH is $19 and for SOL $56; the model flags these as undervalued relative to the projected bull‑case ranges.  

 Downside & Upside Targets  
- Machine‑learning forecasts project a base case of $19 for ETH and $56 for SOL, with panic‑drawdown floors at the deep capitulation zone (June‑August 2026).  
- Bull‑case cycle targets are $8 000 for ETH and $665 000 for SOL, derived from the regression fair‑value bands and the 200‑week SMA support.  
- The model’s cycle bull targets span 6 000–8 000 for ETH and 486 000–665 000 for SOL, indicating a potential upside of roughly 400‑3500 % for ETH and 1180‑1180 % for SOL relative to their base targets.
